title: Global PhD in therapy innovation for lung cancer
field: Biomedical engineering / lung cancer therapy (boron neutron capture therapy)
about: Macquarie University, Australia, invites expressions of interest for a Global PhD in therapy innovation for lung cancer, a joint project with National Tsing Hua University. EOIs go by email to both supervisors and close on 31 January 2027.
requirements: Expression of interest emailed to both supervisors (Macquarie and National Tsing Hua University); the preferred candidate is invited to apply formally to both institutions
card_alt: Card for the Global PhD in therapy innovation for lung cancer at Macquarie University in Sydney, Australia; expressions of interest close 31 Jan 2027. The photo shows the Sydney Opera House and Harbour Bridge in Sydney.
